id: title:Gilbert09:clarify the error shown when a database connection times out

review.posthog_relevance: Updates error messaging for warehouse source connection timeouts, potentially improving user diagnostics for warehouse ingestion failures.
review.reason: The change replaces a generic database connection timeout error message with a more specific one, directing users to check PostHog's egress IP allow-list and database reachability. This is a localized maintenance and documentation improvement.
review.uncertainty: The actual implementation and relevant checks are not fully visible; the benefit is inferred from the change description rather than demonstrated by complete code execution or comprehensive test results.
